parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8288 achieved with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.02, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. It seems the lower LR is working well for this capacity. Next, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR further to 0.01 to see if we can squeeze out more convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.01 to see if a even more conservative learning rate improves convergence on the DEPTH=8 configuration.
